personal.name: Kunal Tiwari
personal.role: Senior Frontend Engineer and full stack developer
personal.intro: I build the interfaces behind financial products: fast, accessible and carefully made. Since 2018 I've shipped production software across fintech, education, testing and media.
personal.statement: I make complicated products feel calm to use.
about: I'm a frontend engineer who is comfortable across the whole stack. I like the work where a design, an API and a slow screen all have to be fixed together, and the person using it only notices that it feels easy.

Today I build features for the Wealth business unit at BlackRock, taking them from idea to production and mentoring the interns on my team. Outside work I take part in hackathons, contribute to open source and chase performance wins.

experience.title: Associate
experience.description: Frontend developer for the Wealth business unit. I deliver critical features end to end and mentor engineering interns.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
experience.description: Sole developer for a prominent fintech company. I built an internationalization system that drove a 30% increase in user engagement.

experience.title: Application Engineer
experience.description: Full stack developer. I designed and shipped a feedback system that fed user data straight into large language models for automated analysis.

experience.title: Senior Systems Engineer
experience.description: Full stack developer. I created GOAT, a testing utility that lets teams validate their applications against predefined test suites.

testimonials.name: Ravindranath Mohanraj
testimonials.text: The trait that impressed me the most in Kunal is his ability to quickly learn and implement the same in real-time projects. Highly motivated and has a thirst to learn new things. Had a pleasure working with him in my team and he was quick in scaling up to meet user requirements and deliver them a quality system.

testimonials.name: Charlotte McAndrew
testimonials.text: Kunal is incredibly hard working and communicative. He takes the challenges of working as a remote team member head on, with a continuous will to understand user needs and learn more every day. Kunal has a very positive attitude and he's a pleasure to work with.

testimonials.name: Amran Ali
testimonials.text: Kunal is a highly skilled front end developer and has shown great full stack progress. He is a fast learner and a great problem solver with a keen eye for design. I would highly recommend Kunal to anyone looking for either a front end developer or a full stack Node.js developer.

testimonials.name: Divyansh Tripathi
testimonials.text: Kunal's contribution to the Education, Training and Assessment department has been tremendous. He is always ready for new challenges and loves to explore upcoming technologies. He is an avid learner and keeps on participating in hackathons and coding competitions. His keen observations have helped in enhancing the value of the content being developed and delivered. With his strong technical and analytical skills, he has already created a name for himself. He is a valuable asset to our team.
